note: Essential IS the on-brand Accenture Song FY26 look. This style pack maps onto the existing engine Song support: decoration:'bar' gives the deconstructed-bar cover / light section dividers / purple 'Thank you', the ACN Song purple palette, and Graphik. Content is light editorial and should use the Song content archetypes (headline + body/bullets + image + built-in 'Accenture Song' footer) — NOT the Premium content_skin, so content_skin is intentionally unset. A real purple-gradient cover background was curated to assets/cover-bg.png; the engine's decoration:'bar' cover currently renders on a flat dark #120A1C field (not the gradient) and the cover.asset branch would suppress the deconstructed bar, so we keep decoration:'bar' for the signature bar and leave the gradient asset available for a future engine tweak.
_cover_asset_note: Purple radial-gradient cover/closing background (1642x923, from PPTX image1.png, clean, no baked text). Not wired to cover.asset because that branch suppresses the deconstructed bar; kept for a future gradient-cover engine option.
